messages:
Mohit: Quick kickoff for the Edge RefKit we're preparing for the Cloud Partner catalog. Scope: terraform starter module (multi-cloud), one minimal example, CI smoke for arm/x86, marketplace metadata, and a 1-page ops playbook. Target: internal staging in 7 days.
Lena: I can own the ops playbook + quickstart (3 cmds). Will include rollback steps and a tiny troubleshooting checklist.
Diego: I'll scaffold the TF module and two examples: examples/minimal and examples/full. Will add `required_version` and provider constraints.
Tara: I'll do CI and the cross-arch test matrix. Plan: run `terraform init`, `validate`, and `fmt -check` in GH Actions; keep it lightweight.
Mohit: also need a short compatibility table: supported regions, provider versions, and whether images support Graviton. Diego, can you add arch notes in README?
Diego: yes, adding an "architecture support" table and a note about arm-compatible AMI/container tags.
Lena: UI note for marketplace: blurb must be <=200 chars, icon 64x64 PNG, no customer screenshots. I'll draft copy and sample icon guidance.
Tara: CI snippet I'll add to the repo (minimal matrix):
```
name: refkit-smoke
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        cloud: [aws, gcp]
        arch: [x86, arm]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v2
      - run: terraform init -input=false
      - run: terraform validate
      - run: terraform fmt -check
```
Diego: I'll include a tiny terraform.tfvars.example for CI so plan runs fast.
Mohit: partner packaging checklist: LICENSE, contributor.md, short screenshot (scrubbed), tags, and a region matrix. Tara, can the CI also run a metadata lint?
Tara: yes, will add a step to run `./scripts/validate-listing.sh` if /packaging/metadata.yaml exists.
Lena: Ops playbook will include SLOs to watch (99th pct latency, token throughput, KV cache hit rate) and a one-page runbook for rollback.
Mohit: timeline: today assign (done). +2 days: initial PRs for module + README + playbook. +4 days: CI matrix + assets. +7 days: publish to partner staging and run smoke window.
Diego: I'll open the module PR by tomorrow EOD with examples and README skeleton.
Tara: I'll stub the GH Action tonight so CI runs on the PR.
Lena: I'll draft the quickstart tonight and add the marketplace blurb.
marketplace-bot: REMINDER: Upload packaging assets to /partner-artifacts and run `./tools/market-validate` before requesting staging publish.
Mohit: thanks all. Can someone volunteer to do the staging verification sign-off? need one person to approve.
Diego: I can sign off if CI & metadata lint pass.
Lena: perfect. Tag me if you need help with the blurb or icons. :thumbsup:
Tara: noted. Will post CI results in the PR thread.
